description: An interactive web dashboard for visualizing and analyzing macroeconomic data using Streamlit, Plotly, and the FRED API.

core_features.name: Macro Snapshot Dashboard
core_features.description: Visualizes key indicators like GDP, CPI (inflation), Unemployment, and Fed Funds Rate. Allows toggle between raw values, YoY % change, and log transformations.

core_features.name: Historical Revisions Tracker (ALFRED)
core_features.description: Explores point-in-time data revisions. Visualizes the difference between initial releases and subsequent revisions using FRED vintage dates.

core_features.name: Dynamic Series Search & Multi-Plot comparison
core_features.description: Provides an in-app search function using fredapi's full-text search capability and allows the user to plot up to 3 custom series side-by-side or on a dual Y-axis.

core_features.name: Export Tool
core_features.description: Enables users to download filtered datasets and comparison views into CSV or Excel formats.

app_structure.app.py: Main entry point for Streamlit application containing page routing and core layout.
app_structure.config.py: API key validation and environment setup.
app_structure.data_fetcher.py: Dedicated utility module wrapping fredapi to fetch and parse series, cache API responses, and run search queries.
app_structure.charts.py: Visualizing functions mapping Pandas dataframes to Plotly interactive figures.

user_paths.name: Full-Text Discovery & Metadata Review
steps: User inputs search query (e.g., 'GDP of America').
Results returned in a structured, sortable Streamlit DataFrame.
User highlights a row and expands the detailed 'notes' container to read the complete methodology and data sources.

user_paths.name: Dynamic Configuration & Plotly Visualization
steps: User selects a specific series ID from search results.
User triggers the Streamlit Configuration Dialog.
Dialog reads and exposes customizable parameters (Units transformation: raw, change, % change, YoY; and Aggregation/Frequency).
User clicks 'Visualize' inside the configuration panel.
App calls 'get_series_observations()' with parameters and renders an interactive Plotly timeline.

ux_specifications.search_ux: Use st.text_input with a debounce/submit button to prevent excessive api hitting. Paginate or limit search results to top 20 by popularity default.
ux_specifications.dialog_ux: Utilize modern st.dialog wrapper. Fetch FRED native transformation parameters (lin, chg, pch, pc1, log) and present as human-readable select boxes.
ux_specifications.chart_ux: Interactive Plotly line chart with dynamic title (Title + Unit + Frequency) and range slider.

hot_cache.purpose: Instantaneous data re-rendering and UI responsiveness during a live user session. Prevents hitting FRED rate limits on immediate page refreshes.

cold_cache.purpose: Saves user configurations, dashboard layouts, bookmarks, and keeps an archive of fetched series data to survive app server restarts.

future_compatibility.config_retention: Supports storing user-defined transformation parameters (e.g., 'CPI' with 'YoY % Change' aggregation).

sqlite_tables.cached_series: Stores parsed date, value, and unit state mappings to prevent server roundtrips.
sqlite_tables.user_configs: Will store bookmark templates containing target indicators and formatting settings.

modular_pipeline.persistence_layer: database.py manages the physical disk storage.
modular_pipeline.api_layer: data_fetcher.py coordinates authentication and routes caching requests between RAM and SQL disk.
modular_pipeline.visual_layer: charts.py handles raw data mapping into modular Plotly express components.
modular_pipeline.ui_controller: app.py dictates routing, rendering dialog forms, and handling application mode bindings.

src/: data_fetcher.py (FRED API interface & Hybrid cache controller)
charts.py (Plotly mapping layout and styling components)
tests/: test_data_fetcher.py (Mock API integrations & error boundary tests)
